reviews.title: Missing CAS Latency (CL)
reviews.comment: Works great, works fast, however the product listing doesn’t disclose the CAS Latency, which is CL38 (not fantastic). It doesn’t affect performance too much but either way, buyer beware. Solid product but there are better alternatives.
